xml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<ncbi_application xmlns="ncbi:application"
 xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
 xs:schemaLocation="ncbi:application ncbi_application.xsd"
>
<program type="regular">
<name>convert2blastmask</name>
<version>0.2.0</version>
<description>Convert masking information in lower-case masked FASTA input to file formats suitable for makeblastdb</description>
<detailed_description></detailed_description>
</program>
<arguments>
<key name="in" type="File_In" optional="true">
<description>Input file name</description>
<synopsis>input_file_name</synopsis>
<default>-</default>
</key>
<key name="masking_algorithm" type="String">
<description>Masking algorithm name (e.g.: dust, seg, windowmasker, repeat). Use 'other' for user-defined type</description>
<synopsis>mask_program_name</synopsis>
</key>
<key name="masking_options" type="String">
<description>Masking algorithm options to create the masked input (free text to describe/include (command line) options used to create the masking)</description>
<synopsis>mask_program_options</synopsis>
</key>
<key name="out" type="File_Out" optional="true">
<description>Output file name</description>
<synopsis>output_file_name</synopsis>
<default>-</default>
</key>
<key name="outfmt" type="String" optional="true">
<description>Output file format</description>
<synopsis>output_format</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>`interval', `maskinfo_asn1_bin', `maskinfo_asn1_text', `maskinfo_xml'</description>
<Strings case_sensitive="true">
<value>interval</value>
<value>maskinfo_asn1_bin</value>
<value>maskinfo_asn1_text</value>
<value>maskinfo_xml</value>
</Strings>
</constraint>
<default>maskinfo_asn1_text</default>
</key>
<flag name="h" optional="true">
<description>Print USAGE and DESCRIPTION;  ignore all other parameters</description>
</flag>
<flag name="help" optional="true">
<description>Print USAGE, DESCRIPTION and ARGUMENTS; ignore all other parameters</description>
</flag>
<flag name="parse_seqids" optional="true">
<description>Parse Seq-ids in FASTA input</description>
</flag>
<flag name="version" optional="true">
<description>Print version number;  ignore other arguments</description>
</flag>
</arguments>
</ncbi_application>
